024import static org.tquadrat.foundation.lang.Objects.hash;
025import static org.tquadrat.foundation.lang.Objects.requireNonNullArgument;
026import static org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.PerformanceTracker.TrackerStatus.STATUS_ABORTED;
027import static org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote.JSONField_Aborted;
028import static org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote.JSONField_Context;
029import static org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote.JSONField_ElapsedTime;
030import static org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote.JSONField_ExceededThreshold;
031import static org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote.JSONField_Section;
032import static org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote.JSONField_SectionDescription;
033import static org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote.JSONField_SectionName;
034import static org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote.JSONField_SectionThreshold;
035import static org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote.JSONField_SectionThresholdOnlyReport;
036import static org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote.JSONField_SectionTimeout;
037import static org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote.JSONField_StartTime;
038import static org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote.JSONField_TimedOut;

046import org.tquadrat.foundation.jsonbuilder.JSONBuilder;
047import org.tquadrat.foundation.lang.Objects;

052/**
053 *  <p>{@summary The container for report data going to the
054 *  {@link org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.PerfLogMBean}.}</p>
055 *  <p>The method
056 *  {@link #toJSON()}
057 *  will generate the report message that is distributed through the
058 *  {@link org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.PerfLogMBean PerfLogMBean}.</p>
059 *
060 *  @extauthor Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
061 *  @version $Id: PerformanceReportImpl.java 1216 2026-05-02 11:16:24Z tquadrat $
062 *  @since 0.25.0
063 *
064 *  @UMLGraph.link
065 */
066@ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: PerformanceReportImpl.java 1216 2026-05-02 11:16:24Z tquadrat $" )
067@API( status = INTERNAL, since = "0.25.0" )
068public final class PerformanceReportImpl implements PerformanceReport
069{
070        /*------------*\
071    ====** Attributes **=======================================================
072        \*------------*/
073    /**
074     *  The optional cause that was added to the report in case the performance
075     *  section was aborted.
076     */
077    private final Throwable m_Cause;
078
079    /**
080     *  <p>{@summary The JSON builder that is used to generated the
081     *  notification messages.}</p>
082     */
083    private final JSONBuilder m_JSONBuilder;
084
085    /**
086     *  An optional message that was issued with the report.
087     */
088    private final String m_Message;
089
090    /**
091     *  The performance section.
092     */
093    private final PerformanceSection m_Section;
094
095    /**
096     *  The performance tracker.
097     */
098    private final PerformanceTrackerImpl m_Tracker;
099
100        /*--------------*\
101    ====** Constructors **=====================================================
102        \*--------------*/
103    /**
104     *  Creates a new instance of {@code PerformanceReportImpl}.
105     *
106     *  @param  tracker The performance tracker with the data to report.
107     *  @param  message An optional message that was issued with this report.
108     *  @param  cause   The optional exception that can be issued in case the
109     *      performance section was aborted.
110     */
111    public PerformanceReportImpl( final PerformanceTracker tracker, final String message, final Throwable cause )
112    {
113        m_Tracker = (PerformanceTrackerImpl) requireNonNullArgument( tracker, "tracker" );
114        m_Section = m_Tracker.getPerformanceSection();
115        m_Message = message; // Is optional,  can be null!
116        m_Cause = cause; // Is optional,  can be null!
117
118        m_JSONBuilder = JSONBuilder.getInstance();
119    }   //  PerformanceReportImpl()
120
121        /*---------*\
122    ====** Methods **==========================================================
123        \*---------*/
124    /**
125     *  {@inheritDoc}
126     */
127    @Override
128    public final boolean equals( final Object o )
129    {
130        var retValue = this == o;
131        if( !retValue && o instanceof final PerformanceReportImpl other )
132        {
133            retValue = m_Tracker.equals( other.m_Tracker )
134                && Objects.equals( m_Message, other.m_Message )
135                && Objects.equals( m_Cause, other.m_Cause );
136        }
137
138        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
139        return retValue;
140    }   //  equals()
141
142    /**
143     *  {@inheritDoc}
144     */
145    @Override
146    public final Optional<Throwable> getCause() { return Optional.ofNullable( m_Cause ); }
147
148    /**
149     *  {@inheritDoc}
150     */
151    @Override
152    public Optional<String> getMessage()
153    {
154        final Optional<String> retValue = isNotEmptyOrBlank( m_Message ) ? Optional.ofNullable( m_Message ) : Optional.empty();
155
156        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
157        return retValue;
158    }   //  getMessage()
159
160    /**
161     *  {@inheritDoc}
162     */
163    @Override
164    public final PerformanceSection getPerformanceSection() { return m_Section; }
165
166    /**
167     *  {@inheritDoc}
168     */
169    @Override
170    public final PerformanceTracker getPerformanceTracker() { return m_Tracker; }
171
172    /**
173     *  {@inheritDoc}
174     */
175    @Override
176    public final int hashCode() { return hash( m_Tracker, m_Cause, m_Message ); }
177
178    /**
179     *  <p>{@summary Returns the contents of this report instance as a JSON
180     *  string.}</p>
181     *  <p>The JSON has the following structure:</p>
182     *  <ul>
183     *      <li>{@value org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote#JSONField_Section}
184     *      [Object] – The definition of the
185     *      {@link org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.PerformanceSection}.
186     *      <ul>
187     *          <li>{@value org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote#JSONField_SectionName}
188     *          [String] – The name of the performance section.</li>
189     *          <li>{@value org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote#JSONField_SectionDescription}
190     *          [String] – The description for the performance section.</li>
191     *          <li>{@value org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote#JSONField_SectionThresholdOnlyReport}
192     *          [Boolean] – Indicates whether a report is sent only when the threshold was exceeded.</li>
193     *          <li>{@value org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote#JSONField_SectionThreshold}
194     *          [optional Object] – The threshold time from the performance section.
195     *          <ul>
196     *              <li>{@value JSONBuilder#JSONField_Unit} [String] – The
197     *              dimension.</li>
198     *              <li>{@value JSONBuilder#JSONField_Value} [Number] – The
199     *              value.</li>
200     *          </ul>
201     *          </li>
202     *          <li>{@value org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote#JSONField_SectionTimeout}
203     *          [optional Object] – The timeout time from the performance section.
204     *          <ul>
205     *              <li>{@value JSONBuilder#JSONField_Unit} [String] – The
206     *              dimension.</li>
207     *              <li>{@value JSONBuilder#JSONField_Value} [Number] – The
208     *              value.</li>
209     *          </ul>
210     *          </li>
211     *      </ul>
212     *      </li>
213     *      <li>{@value org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote#JSONField_StartTime} [String] – The start time; the
214     *      time when the performance section was entered.</li>
215     *      <li>{@value org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote#JSONField_ElapsedTime} [optional Object] – The time
216     *      that was spent in the performance section. Only present when the
217     *      operation was not aborted.
218     *      <ul>
219     *          <li>{@value JSONBuilder#JSONField_Unit} [String] – The
220     *          dimension.</li>
221     *          <li>{@value JSONBuilder#JSONField_Value} [Number] – The
222     *          value.</li>
223     *      </ul>
224     *      </li>
225     *      <li>{@value org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote#JSONField_Context}
226     *      [optional Object] – The context for
227     *      the current execution of the performance section. The member names
228     *      are specific for the respective performance section.</li>
229     *      <li>{@value org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote#JSONField_Message}
230     *      [optional String] – A message that was issued with this
231     *      report.</li>
232     *      <li>{@value org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.remote.PerfLogRemote#JSONField_Cause}
233     *      [optional String] – An exception that was issued with this report
234     *      as the reason for aborting the performance section.</li>
235     *  </ul>
236     *
237     *  @return A JSON formatted representation of this report instance.
238     */
239    @SuppressWarnings( "PublicMethodNotExposedInInterface" )
240    public final String toJSON()
241    {
242        final var json = m_JSONBuilder.createObject();
243        final var section = json.setObject( JSONField_Section );
244
245        section.set( JSONField_SectionName, m_Section.getName().toString() )
246            .set( JSONField_SectionDescription, m_Section.getDescription() )
247            .set( JSONField_SectionThresholdOnlyReport, m_Section.isSendingReportOnlyForExceededThreshold() );
248        m_Section.getThreshold().ifPresent( v -> section.set( JSONField_SectionThreshold, v, MILLISECOND ) );
249        m_Section.getTimeout().ifPresent( v -> section.set( JSONField_SectionTimeout, v, MILLISECOND ) );
250
251        final var startTime = m_Tracker.getTimestamp().atZone( UTC );
252        json.set( JSONField_StartTime, startTime.format( ISO_OFFSET_DATE_TIME ) );
253        m_Tracker.getElapsedTime().ifPresent( v -> json.set( JSONField_ElapsedTime, v, MILLISECOND) );
254        json.set( JSONField_ExceededThreshold, m_Tracker.isThresholdExceeded() )
255            .set( JSONField_TimedOut, m_Tracker.isTimedOut() )
256            .set( JSONField_Aborted, m_Tracker.getStatus() == STATUS_ABORTED );
257
258        final var context = m_Tracker.getContext();
259        if( !context.isEmpty() )
260        {
261            final var contextObject = json.setObject( JSONField_Context );
262            for( final var entry : context.entrySet() )
263            {
264                contextObject.set( entry.getKey(), entry.getValue() );
265            }
266        }
267
268        final var retValue = json.toString();
269
270        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
271        return retValue;
272    }   //  toJSON()
273
274    /**
275     *  {@inheritDoc}
276     */
277    @Override
278    public final String toString() { return ""; }
279}
280//  class PerformanceReportImpl
